## Group 22: What's Trending in Gaming on Bluesky?

```{r config, include = FALSE}
library(dotenv)
library(atrrr)
library(dplyr)
library(wordcloud)
library(tm)

load("../data/clean/tdm.RData")
```

#### Word-cloud functions.

```{r unweightedWordCloud, echo=FALSE}
freqs = rowSums(M)
freqs = freqs[!is.na(freqs)]
wordcloud(
  names(freqs),
  freqs,
  random.order = FALSE,
  min.freq = 10,
  max.words = 500,
  colors = brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"),
  scale = c(2, .5)
)
title("Common words in gaming - Unweighted")
```
```{r weightedWordCloud, echo=FALSE}
tdmw = weightTfIdf(tdm)
T = as.matrix(tdmw)

# Sum weighted frequencies across documents.
freqsw = rowSums(T)
wordcloud(
  names(freqsw),
  freqsw,
  random.order = FALSE,
  min.freq = 6,
  max.words = 500,
  colors = brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"),
  scale = c(1, .5)
)
title("Common words in gaming - Weighted")
```
